identity_contract: exact int8 labels; exact float64 observations; per-vector z-normalized observations rounded to10decimal; array hash dtype+shape header; all prior label or observation matches excluded

selection.rule: Prespecify WSD,Stock,MSL. Reject any prior selected name or matching exact label, exact observation, or z-normalized observation rounded to10decimals. Sort each remaining family by (n,id). For m>12 select floor(i*(m-1)/11), i=0..11; otherwise select all. No metric, score-cardinality, or runtime selection.
selection.uncertainty_target: Six paired full-workflow repetitions estimate timing variation for this fixed panel only; no recording-population CI or independent-source claim.

score_contract.data_contract: Parse original CSV order. X=all non-Label columns float64, y=Label int8. Require finite X and binary y with both classes; no silent dropna or crop. Pass X to unmodified public API. Require 1D finite output with exactly n elements. Persist npy without rounding. Preserve genuine ties and source preprocessing. Freeze all score hashes before metrics. No selection based on detector quality.
score_contract.known_limit: COPOD has no Optimal_Uni_algo_HP_dict entry; use the public API directly. This is an imported-score TimeEval workload with a documented adapter, not unchanged Run_Detector_U.py or historical TimeEval outputs.
score_contract.public_preprocessing: Both FFT.fit and COPOD.fit apply upstream zscore(axis=0,ddof=0), which includes np.nan_to_num in upstream utility. Preserve this source preprocessing; adapter performs no extra repair.
